# What Integrations does BombBomb Support?

Sharice Rodriguez·April 23, 2025 at 4:30 PM

## Overview

An integration is a direct connection between your BombBomb account and another platform. This article covers every integration BombBomb supports and explains what each one does so you can find the right fit for your workflow.

**Who this applies to:** All Users

**Plan requirement:** Core, Core + Copilot, Enterprise

* * *

## A Note on Browser Extensions and Mobile Apps

The BombBomb Browser Extension and Mobile App are not integrations — they do not create a direct connection to another platform. However, they solve many of the same problems customers look to integrations to solve, so they are worth understanding first.

**Browser Extension (Chrome & Edge):** Adds BombBomb recording to your browser toolbar so you can record and share videos from anywhere on the web. Also injects BombBomb functionality into Gmail and LinkedIn — so you can record and insert videos without leaving those pages. No separate integration with Gmail or LinkedIn is required.

**Mobile App (iOS & Android):** BombBomb on your phone. Record and send videos from anywhere.

If you are asking "can I use BombBomb inside X tool?" — the browser extension answers that question for most tools. See [How to Install and Use the BombBomb Browser Extension](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/36073249519757-What-Integrations-does-BombBomb-Support#).

* * *

## Standard Integrations — Built by BombBomb

These create a direct connection between BombBomb and your CRM or sales platform. Your reps access BombBomb from inside the platform and record and send videos from within contact records, deals, or sequences — without leaving the tool.

| Integration | Works in Classic | Works in Engage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HubSpot | No | Yes |
| Microsoft Dynamics Customer Insights | No | Yes |
| Outreach | Yes | Yes |
| Total Expert | Yes | Yes |
| Zendesk | Yes | Yes |
| Follow Up Boss | Yes | Yes |

## Automated Workflow Connectors — Built by BombBomb

An Automated Workflow Connector passes BombBomb video tracking data — opens, plays, clicks — back into your CRM so it appears alongside your other contact activity. This is a separate and optional connection. Automated Workflows send videos with or without it.

**Available for:** HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics Customer Insights, Outreach, Total Expert.

**Article for each connector:**

- Hubspot Automated Workflow Connector
- Microsoft Dynamics Customer Insights Automated Workflow Connector
- Outreach Automated Workflow Connector
- Total Expert Automated Workflow Connector

* * *

## Email & Communication Integrations — Built by BombBomb

| Integration | What It Does | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| BombBomb Outlook Add-in | Record, insert, send, and track videos directly from Outlook | Live |
| Send Video Emails via Outlook | Connects Outlook to BombBomb Engage so your video emails are sent through Outlook's mail servers | Live |
| Send Video Emails via Gmail | Connects Gmail to BombBomb Engage so your video emails are sent through Gmail's mail servers | **Coming soon!** |

**Note:** The Outlook Add-in and Send Video Emails via Outlook are two separate features that do not depend on each other.

**Articles:**

- [How to Install and Use the BombBomb Outlook Add-in](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/36073135831309)
- [How to Send Video Emails via Outlook](https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/41026319722637)
